query:
select
display_id as "Patient ID",
first_name as "First name",
last_name as "Last name",
to_char(date_of_birth, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Date of birth",
age as "Age",
sex as "Sex",
village as "Village",
nationality as "Nationality",
place_of_death as "Place of death",
department as "Department",
location_group as "Area",
location as "Location",
to_char(date_of_death, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Date of death",
attending_clinician as "Attending clinician",
primary_cause_condition as "Primary cause of death",
time_between_onset_and_death as "Time between onset and death",
antecedent_cause_1 as "Antecedent cause 1",
antecedent_cause_2 as "Antecedent cause 2",
other_condition_1 as "Other condition 1",
other_condition_2 as "Other condition 2",
other_condition_3 as "Other condition 3",
other_condition_4 as "Other condition 4",
had_recent_surgery as "Had recent surgery",
to_char(last_surgery_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Last surgery date",
reason_for_surgery as "Reason for surgery",
manner_of_death as "Manner of death",
to_char(external_cause_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "External cause date",
external_cause_location as "External cause location",
was_pregnant as "Was pregnant",
pregnancy_contributed as "Pregnancy contributed",
was_fetal_or_infant as "Was fetal or infant",
was_stillborn as "Was stillborn",
birth_weight as "Birth weight (kg)",
completed_weeks_of_pregnancy as "Completed weeks of pregnancy",
age_of_mother as "Age of mother",
condition_in_mother_affecting_fetus_or_newborn as "Condition in mother affecting fetus or newborn",
death_within_day_of_birth as "Death within day of birth",
hours_survived_since_birth as "Hours survived since birth"
from "reporting"."ds__deaths"
where date_of_death >= 
:fromDate
and date_of_death <= 
:toDate
and case
when 
:causeOfDeath is null
then true
else primary_cause_condition_id = 
:causeOfDeath
end
and case
when 
:mannerOfDeath is null
then true
else manner_of_death = 
:mannerOfDeath
end
and case
when 
:facilityId is null
then true
else facility_id = 
:facilityId
end
and case
when 
:antecedentCause is null
then true
else antecedent_cause_1_id = 
:antecedentCause
or antecedent_cause_2_id = 
:antecedentCause
end
and case
when 
:otherContributingCondition is null
then true
else other_condition_1_id = 
:otherContributingCondition
or other_condition_2_id = 
:otherContributingCondition
or other_condition_3_id = 
:otherContributingCondition
or other_condition_4_id = 
:otherContributingCondition
end
order by date_of_death
name: Deceased patients line list
notes:
This report generates a list of all deceased patients within the selected parameters. Patients are listed in chronological order by date and time of death. 
The report includes all details documented in the patient death record.

parameters.label: Due to (or as a consequence of)
parameters.name: antecedentCause
